title: Order symmetry and orthogonality of trajectories in discrete interval exchange transformations
summary: Let $π=(<_D,<_A)$ be a pair of distinct orders on a $k$-letter alphabet $A. $ The periodic trajectories $v_i^\infty $ of a discrete $k$-interval exchange transformations $T$ with permutation $π$ are characterized by the following order symmetry : $v_i^ω<_D v_j^ω$ (lexicographically) if and only if $v_i^{-ω}<_Av_j^{-ω}$ (reverse lexicographically). For general words $u$ and $v$ over $A$, the orders need not agree in which case either $u^ω<_A v^ω<_D u^ω$ (Type 1) or $v^ω<_A u^ω<_D v^ω$ (Type 2).
